You fight with swords?\nOkay!
If you've acquired Blade Skills, you should\nlevel up [ffff64]Hard Hit[ffffff] first!
You fight with bows?\nOkay!
If you've acquired Shot Skills, you should\nlevel up [ffff64]Power Shot[ffffff] first!
You fight with staffs?\nOkay!
If you've acquired Magic Skills, you should\nlearn [ffff64]MP Charge[ffffff] first.
[ffff64]MP Charge restores MP.[ffffff] It's really useful if you\nuse staffs. I'm sure you can defeat monsters\nmuch more easily with it.
After you learn MP Charge, why don't you\nlevel up [ffff64]Magic: Arrows[ffffff]? It's a magic attack skill!
You fight with knuckles?\nOkay!
If you've acquired Martial Skills, you should\nlevel up [ffff64]Smash[ffffff] first!
You fight with halberds!\nOkay!
I'd recommend that you level up [ffff64]Flash Stab[ffffff] first\nif you handle halberds.
You fight with katanas!\nOkay!
If you have learned Mononofu Skills, I recommend\nyou learn [ffff64]Two-Handed[ffffff] first.
Two-Handed is an important skill that greatly\nenhances your katana abilities! It will be\nmuch easier to beat monsters if you learn it.
After learning Two-Handed, you should level up\nyour [ffff64]Issen[ffffff] skill!
After that, you can learn or level up any skills\nas you wish.
Open [64ffff]Menu > Character > Skills[ffffff] and choose the\nskills you want to learn or level up!
